Container.Name: BackupDrill
Container.Overview:
Backs up a Supabase project's Postgres database, and optionally its Storage files, to an S3, Cloudflare R2 or Backblaze B2 bucket you own. Each snapshot includes a manifest.json with estimated table row counts and SHA-256 checksums for the database dump and copied Storage files, plus a RECOVERY.md with restore steps.
The container runs a backup on the cron schedule you set and stays idle in between. Nothing is stored inside the container and no data goes through our servers: pg_dump streams straight from Supabase to your bucket.
Use the Session pooler connection string from the Supabase dashboard (Connect, then Session pooler). Every backup is egress on your Supabase bill, so start weekly and read the cost notes in the README before going daily. Add a Healthchecks.io ping URL to get an alert when a run fails or doesn't happen.
The CLI is open source (MIT): https://github.com/backupdrill/cli
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: supabase postgres postgresql pg_dump database backup s3 r2 b2 restore
Container.Requires: A Supabase project and an S3-compatible bucket with access keys.

Config.Name: Schedule (cron)
Config.Description: When to run a backup, as a cron expression in the server's time zone. The default is Sundays at 03:00. Leave empty to run one backup each time the container starts.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: Supabase Session pooler connection string with the database password filled in, e.g. postgresql://postgres.PROJECT_REF:PASSWORD@aws-0-REGION.pooler.supabase.com:5432/postgres

Config.Name: Project name
Config.Description: A readable name used in the bucket path and the manifest.

Config.Name: Bucket endpoint
Config.Description: S3-compatible endpoint, e.g. https://ACCOUNT_ID.r2.cloudflarestorage.com for R2 or https://s3.us-west-004.backblazeb2.com for B2. Leave empty for AWS S3.

Config.Name: Bucket region
Config.Description: Bucket region. auto works for R2; AWS S3 needs the bucket's region, e.g. eu-central-1.

Config.Name: Bucket access key ID
Config.Description: Access key ID for the destination bucket.

Config.Name: Bucket secret access key
Config.Description: Secret access key for the destination bucket.

Config.Name: Healthchecks ping URL
Config.Description: Optional. A Healthchecks.io ping URL; each run pings start, then success or failure.

Config.Name: Bucket key prefix
Config.Description: Folder inside the bucket that snapshots go under.

Config.Name: Storage S3 endpoint
Config.Description: Optional, to also back up Storage files: the endpoint shown under Storage, Settings, S3 Access Keys, e.g. https://PROJECT_REF.storage.supabase.co/storage/v1/s3. Set all four Storage fields or none.

Config.Name: Storage S3 region
Config.Description: The region shown on the same Supabase page.

Config.Name: Storage S3 access key ID
Config.Description: Supabase Storage S3 access key ID. These keys bypass row level security, so keep them on this server only.

Config.Name: Storage S3 secret access key
Config.Description: Supabase Storage S3 secret access key.

Config.Name: Storage buckets
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated list of Storage buckets to copy. Leave empty for all of them.
